title: SO(k)-Invariant Gauge Rigidity for Declared Euclidean Stalks: Local ℓ² Selection and Outer ℓ¹ Aggregation (GS-002)
description: Within the framework of cohomological obstruction theory, this preprint gives local rigidity results for gauges on declared Euclidean stalks. Under an explicitly declared strong edgewise aggregation rule, substituting those local factors yields the weighted ℓ¹(E; ℓ²) form; the outer sum is conditional and definitional, not a consequence of SO(k) symmetry alone. The general M-compatible classification used as Theorem 2.1 is imported evidence from a companion paper and is not locally proved here.
notes: Preprint candidate for GS-002 (v2.0.0). Text is CC-BY-4.0; code and Lean 4 formalization are Apache-2.0.
